matn_replacements: Human life depends upon water, soil, plants, animals and the labour of other people. Water, soil, animals, plants and the capacities of the human body make provision possible, but their benefits are obtained through knowledge, labour and cooperation.
Human life depends upon land, water, plants, animals and the labour of others. People use knowledge and practical skill to cultivate, herd and transform the resources on which they depend.
Such work requires observation, skill and cooperation. It also creates obligations among people whose livelihoods depend upon one another.
These activities require cooperation and give people responsibilities toward those whose work makes their livelihoods possible.

Their initial pledge at al-ʿAqabah concerned belief and conduct; a later pledge undertook the Prophet's defence if he joined them. The later pledge placed the people of Yathrib under a new responsibility: they undertook to defend the Prophet and those who would join him, even at risk to themselves.

The first pledge at al-ʿAqabah concerned belief and conduct. In the later pledge, the people of Yathrib undertook to protect the Prophet and those who would join him, accepting the danger this might bring to their own households.

The Jewish cultivators of Khaybar continued working its fields under an agreement with the Muslim authorities. An arrangement allowed Jewish cultivators to remain and work for a specified share of produce. The arrangement required continued cultivation and the division of each harvest.

Under an agreement with the Muslim authorities, Jewish cultivators continued working Khaybar's fields in return for an agreed share of the produce. The settlement required cooperation over successive harvests.
